import cv2, numpy as np

# Let's inspect obs_0033:
# Pose 33: pos=(0.5, 3.3), heading=90 (facing +x)
img33 = cv2.imread('/work/observations/obs_0033.png')
# Sofa and Plant 2 are straight ahead in +x direction
# Let's check sofa mask:
sofa_mask = (img33[:,:,0] > 100) & (img33[:,:,0] < 140) & (img33[:,:,1] > 100) & (img33[:,:,1] < 140) & (img33[:,:,2] > 100) & (img33[:,:,2] < 140)
ys, xs = np.where(sofa_mask & (np.arange(512)[:, None] > 300))
print('Sofa in obs 33: xs:', xs.min(), xs.max(), 'ys:', ys.min(), ys.max())
contact_y = ys.max()
center_x = (xs.min() + xs.max()) / 2.0
f, h, cy, cx = 256.0, 1.55, 255.5, 255.5
d = f * h / (contact_y - cy)
dx = (center_x - cx) * d / f
# heading 90: world_x = cam_x + d = 0.5 + d, world_y = cam_y - dx = 3.3 - dx
sofa_x = 0.5 + d
sofa_y = 3.3 - dx
print(f'Sofa from obs 33: d={d:.3f}, dx={dx:.3f} -> x={sofa_x:.3f}, y={sofa_y:.3f}')

# Plant 2 in obs 33:
pot_mask = (img33[:,:,2] > 140) & (img33[:,:,0] < 80) & (img33[:,:,1] < 100)
pys, pxs = np.where(pot_mask & (np.arange(512)[None, :] < 200))
if len(pys) > 0:
    contact_y_p = pys.max()
    center_x_p = (pxs.min() + pxs.max()) / 2.0
    d_p = f * h / (contact_y_p - cy)
    dx_p = (center_x_p - cx) * d_p / f
    plant2_x = 0.5 + d_p
    plant2_y = 3.3 - dx_p
    print(f'Plant 2 from obs 33: d={d_p:.3f}, dx={dx_p:.3f} -> x={plant2_x:.3f}, y={plant2_y:.3f}')
"
